condition_rule: Every claim inherits all common_conditions and adds its own conditions; do not extract a claim without both.

conditions: Same Service Information and IP-CAN session
The received Retry-Interval is in the AA-Answer for the applicable rejection
claims.conclusion: Do not resend that information before the interval expires; this does not independently authorize retry.
REQUESTED_SERVICE_NOT_AUTHORIZED (5063) is classified as a permanent failure: the request should not be attempted again. Expiry of a waiting interval does not change that classification.
